test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (2500 × 7 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = (52500) / 100

⇒ SI = 525

**The simple interest on ₹2500 at 7% per year for 3 years is ₹525.**
